turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds absolutely delicious and the perfect post-workout meal. Speaking of staying active, have you been able to take your bike out around Minneapolis lately, or is the weather still keeping you off the trails?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! Hopefully the winter weather clears up soon. Have you had any chance to do some photography lately, or are you waiting for warmer days for that too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually took my camera out over the weekend. I walked down by the river and got some really cool high-contrast shots of the melting ice. It was nice to practice focusing on textures.

turns.speaker: assistant
